showcase.scope: Local browser verification of the packaged dashboard, six panes, role routes, architecture downloads, eleven screenshots, feedback and guide; public showcase publication is a separate step.

features: Local dated Geoapify/OpenStreetMap snapshot for 39 selected cities, with five Safadasht listings
Same-origin snapshot download; no city or health data sent to a map provider by the public lookup
Explicit uncovered-city and ambiguous-city recovery with canonical province/county selection
Conservative category/title exclusions; no verified-care claims
Neshan destination links and independent 115 symptom guidance preserved
Portable Node24/SQLite live gateway and isolated Worker included, not publicly deployed

publication.status: published and public HTTPS assets verified

limitations: City-center snapshot radius is not patient distance or verified nearest care.
Listings are provider categories/name-filtered and not verified for availability, opening hours or clinical suitability.
Six selected cities omitted because geocoder could not confirm exact city identity; unlisted cities are explicitly not covered.
Public browser uses the same-origin dated file, not live upstream requests.
VPS runtime tested locally; no remote VPS or TLS deployment performed.
Demo clinical data stays in this browser; real SMS, bank and shared clinical operations remain unconnected.

baseline.scope: Prior unchanged component checks retained as history; not counted as reruns in2.3.2.

artifacts.scope: Complete source, built snapshot-mode app, presentation, current guides and optional live gateway configuration; live public gateway not deployed.

validation.scopedValidation: 57 individual checks: 26 browser, 11 client lifecycle, 12 provider gateway, 6 portable HTTP gateway, 2 public configuration; parent containers excluded. Lint, typecheck and all three builds passed. Actual live provider collection and local HTTP boundary are separate evidence.
